homePageDes: Designing a cashier program is one of the essential requirements that must be available in any place with commercial activities, such as companies, various types of retail stores, warehouses, showrooms, and other units that deal with people in a cash manner. It serves as the accounting book that includes every activity carried out by the retail store or company only.
